regime_context: The TSX narrative detector shows Big Banks leading with strongest momentum, broad breadth, and no crowding. Base Metals sits as a challenger but with zero breadth, undermining conviction. The absolute-trend gate has historically cut drawdown (gate_helps=true), and macro headlines are dominated by AI/geopolitics. The environment supports a few conditional directional leans, but no predictive edge exists.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper: currently the rank-2 challenger but with zero breadth (0.0). Watch for a confirmed handoff; kill the watch if the margin vs. Big Banks widens to >0.8 or breadth stays at 0.0 for five more sessions without improvement.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks hold the top relative-momentum rank, are trend-eligible, show strong internal breadth (0.857) and moderate durability (0.66), with no crowding. The absolute-trend gate has historically improved risk control, and this theme remains safely inside that regime. An overweight lean reflects trend-following discipline, not a return forecast.
evidence: rank 1, eligible, durability 0.66, breadth 0.857, crowded false
theses.dissent: A rapid shift to rate cuts or credit stress could trigger a sharp reversal in bank shares.

falsifier.text: If ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and the weekly trend signal turns negative (loss of eligibility), or if breadth collapses below 0.5.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Despite trend eligibility, Oil & Gas Producers carry negative relative momentum (score -0.065), a mean-reverting tag, and high breadth typical of a mature trend at risk of mean-reversion. An underweight lean reduces exposure relative to the benchmark without attempting to time a fade.
evidence: score -0.065, eligible, durability 0.63, breadth 0.8, mean-revert hurst tag
theses.dissent: A geopolitical supply shock or sharp oil-price spike could instantly revive momentum.

falsifier.text: If the score turns positive and holds above 0 for 5 consecutive trading days, invalidating the negative-momentum premise.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology has negative momentum (score -0.3), is flagged as crowded (crowding_z 1.19), and while still trend-eligible, it shows deteriorating relative strength and positioning risk. Avoid means zero exposure; trend eligibility prevents an outright underweight or fade call.
theses.dissent: An AI-driven sentiment surge could re-rate TSX tech rapidly.

falsifier.text: If XIT.TO overtakes Big Banks in rank and its momentum score rises above 0.2 while crowding subsides (crowding_z < 1) for 5 days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
